_comment: Permissions posture: FULL AUTONOMY. The running factory launches the Editor with --dangerously-skip-permissions (see scripts/editor_entrypoint.sh), so this allow list does NOT govern the autonomous agents — it is only a convenience for a human who opens this repo in interactive Claude Code. The non-root container user (Dockerfile) is what makes skip-permissions possible. To switch to the allowlist posture, drop that flag from the entrypoint and make this list exhaustive.
